Build your career at SCOR Bucharest, where top Romanian and international talent shape the future of reinsurance business, finance and technology – keeping SCOR at the forefront of innovation worldwide.
At SCOR  Bucharest, we offer a dynamic environment where career growth is actively supported through internal mobility, globally recognized certifications, and continuous professional development.
